architectureDecision.stage1: Detect typed entity spans and abstention independently; candidateId must be unique and all labels/evidence text are server-materialized from validated half-open spans.
architectureDecision.stage2: Decode an allowlisted predicate and directed endpoints only over a server-owned immutable candidate table. Source text may be provided at runtime as bounded server-owned context, but stage 2 cannot create, resize, retype or rename entity candidates.
architectureDecision.postProcessing: Trigger/evidence materialization and all endpoint, clause, allowlist and span checks remain server-owned and fail closed.
stage2DirectSourceAccessConditions: The source is runtime-only and is not persisted in evaluation artifacts.
The candidate table and predicate allowlist are authoritative; source text cannot be used to invent endpoints.
Predicted-entity and gold-entity arms receive the same context policy and differ only in the candidate table.

pairedControls: same development cases and run order
same model, prompt template, schema, sampling, timeout and token bounds
same source-context policy and scoring contract
candidate table is the only intended arm difference
oracleDecision.goldRelationsArm: Deterministic zero-provider evaluator/materializer integrity control; it is not a model score.
oracleDecision.eligibilityRule: A strong gold-entities arm cannot promote a weak predicted-entities arm; both applicable arm thresholds must pass.

requirements: Version a deterministic matching and precedence algorithm before preregistration.
Each semantic prediction/gold disposition appears in exactly one semantic bucket.
Evidence buckets use the registered semantic-true-positive denominator and reconcile independently.
Per-case counts must sum to their registered denominators; aggregate only from per-case records.

minimumDenominators.namedSlicePolicy: Every required named slice must have its preregistered minimum denominator or the experiment is ineligible.

approvedThresholds.sliceRule: All applicable preregistered named slices must pass with no material regression; pooled metrics cannot compensate for a failed eligible slice.

requiredBeforePreregistration: Version the stage-1 entity envelope and stage-2 relation-decoding envelope.
Implement the mutually exclusive semantic/evidence bucket scorer and denominator reconciliation tests.
Implement deterministic gold-relations integrity fixtures and both gold-/predicted-entity oracle fixtures offline.
Freeze case selection, paired arm schedule, provider-call accounting, sanitized report schema and cost proof.
Demonstrate unauthorized and invalid-contract paths perform zero provider calls.
Issue a separate owner review of the completed offline package before preregistration or execution.
